news.headline: With top receiver Nico Collins back in the fold after a hamstring strain, Stroud posted his best numbers of the season -
news.detail: With top receiver Nico Collins back in the fold after a hamstring strain, Stroud posted his best numbers of the season -- he threw for 353 yards in Week 2, but it came on 55 attempts and he didn't produce a TD. Both of Stroud's scores Sunday went to Collins, and through four games he has a 5:0 TD:IN
